description: This file contains unit tests for the CredentialsClientImpl class, verifying its behavior in different scenarios for retrieving credentials, including cache hits, cache misses, and error cases.

classes.name: CredentialsClientImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of CredentialsClientImpl, including cache behavior and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixtures with mocked dependencies before each test.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsInvokesServiceIfNoCacheConfigured
methods.description: Verifies that credentials are fetched from the service if no cache is set.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsAddsResponseToCacheOnCacheMiss
methods.description: Checks that on a cache miss, the credentials are retrieved from the service and stored in the cache.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsReturnsValueFromCache
methods.description: Ensures that a cached credentials result is returned without making a service call.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsWithSendError
methods.description: Tests that the method fails properly when the sender cannot send messages due to full queue.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsWithRejectedRequest
methods.description: Verifies proper failure handling when the request is rejected by the service.
